summary: Cronos Group filed an 8-K reporting a share repurchase program of up to $50 million authorized by its Board, intended to succeed the existing program expiring May 13, 2026. The program is expected to commence May 14, 2026; terms beyond aggregate authorization were not disclosed. The filing also included an amendment to extend the long-stop date for the CanAdelaar acquisition to September 9, 2026, and first-quarter earnings results. The buyback signals capital return to shareholders; watch for actual open-market purchases and potential impact on share price and earnings per share.
